ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: (TEXT(Status__c) == "Closed Permanently" || TEXT(Status__c) == "Closed Temporarily") && ( (ISBLANK(TEXT(Closure_Reason__c )) && !(( TPB_Is_Indirect__c || ISNEW()) && TPB_RecordTypeName__c == 'Wholesaler')) || (ISCHANGED(Status__c) && ParentId != null && !Parent_Owner__c && Ownership__c != 'Independent' && TPB_RecordTypeName__c == 'Retailer') )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: 1. When the Account status is Closed Permanently/Temporarily, the Closure Reason cannot be empty. 2. If this is a retailer account, please first ensure you are the Parent Account owner.
